description_ru: Взвешенное мнение о плюсах и минусах удалённой работы и о том, какой формат лучше всего.
text:
Since the pandemic, millions of people have started working from home, and I have been one of them for three years. My opinion is simple: remote work is wonderful, but only if you do it the right way.

Let me begin with the good things. I no longer spend two hours a day on a crowded train. I save money on lunches and clothes, and I can take a walk in the middle of the day when my head is tired. As a result, I feel healthier and I get more done.

However, there are problems too. At home, the line between work and rest becomes very thin. Sometimes I answer emails at ten o'clock at night, and I have even caught myself checking my laptop at weekends. Also, I miss the small conversations in the office. A joke by the coffee machine can cheer you up more than a long video meeting.

Because of these problems, I believe the best solution is a mixture. If I could choose, I would work from home on three days and go to the office on two. That way I would enjoy quiet time for concentration and also keep in touch with my colleagues.

Employers should remember that trust is important. If they treat workers like adults and judge them by their results, not by their hours at a desk, everyone benefits. In the end, a job is something we do, not a place we go.

focus_sounds.tip_ru: Округлите и вытяните губы вперёд, не касаясь зубами нижней губы; это не русское «в».
Кончик языка слегка просуньте между зубами и выдохните без голоса; не заменяйте звук на с или ф.
Кончик языка поднят к нёбу и не касается его, не вибрирует; губы чуть округлены.
